fields.name: Śrī Haridāsa Ṭhākura
fields.aka: Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrī Haridās Ṭhākura, Nāmācārya, Yavana Haridāsa, Brahma-Haridāsa
fields.appearance: Agrahāyaṇa, 1372 Śaka (1451), in the house of Khānaullā Kāzī (Advaita-vilāsa, appendix)
fields.disappearance: Bhādra śukla caturdaśī (Gauḍīya calendar), in Jagannātha Purī, chanting the Lord's name before Him; the Lord buried him in the sand by the sea (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Antya 11)
fields.place: Born at Buḍhan (old Jessore, now Satkhira, Khulna); Phuliyā near Śāntipura; Benāpol; Harinadī; Cāndpur; Navadvīpa; Siddha-bakula in Purī (samādhi in Purī)
fields.guru: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; lived with Advaita Ācārya, with whom he studied
fields.notes:
The Nāmācārya, who chanted 300,000 names a day. Born in a Muslim family (some say a brāhmaṇa), orphaned and brought up by Muslims; studied with Advaita Ācārya (Advaita-prakāśa). Beaten in twenty-two market-places without giving up the name (Caitanya-bhāgavata Ādi 16); converted Rāmacandra Khān's prostitute at Benāpol (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Antya 3); preached with Nityānanda; in Purī lived at Siddha-bakula; left his body before the Lord (Antya 11). Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna, «Haridāsa Ṭhākura».

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Brahmā, with Prahlāda; also Brahmā Mahātapā, son of Ṛcīka Muni (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 93-95).

Paramparā (Gauḍīya Sampradāya chart, 04-11-2026): associate of Advaita Ācārya (disputed): he lived with Advaita; the old sources give no formal initiation.

The record had Rādhākṛṣṇa Cakravartī as his disciple and the Daśa-ślokī-bhāṣya as his work: they belong to Haridāsa Paṇḍita of Vṛndāvana (his own record).

fields.name: Śrī Narahari Sarakāra Ṭhākura
fields.aka: Narahari Sarakāra Ṭhākura, Narahari Sarkara, Narahari dāsa, Sarakāra Ṭhākura
fields.disappearance: Agrahāyaṇa kṛṣṇa ekādaśī, c. 1540 (Bhakti-ratnākara 9.513; Gauḍīya calendar: Keśava kṛṣṇa ekādaśī)
fields.place: Śrīkhaṇḍa, four miles west of Kāṭoyā (Burdwan)
fields.works: Bhakti-candrikā-paṭala; Śrī Kṛṣṇa-bhajanāmṛta; Śrī Caitanya-sahasra-nāma (with Dvija Haridāsa); Śacīnandanāṣṭaka; Rādhāṣṭaka; songs (some in the Padakalpataru)
fields.notes:
A Vaidya of Śrīkhaṇḍa. Father: Nārāyaṇa dāsa (Nārāyaṇa Deva); mother: Śrī Goyī Devī, daughter of Murāri Sena; brothers Mukunda (father of Raghunandana Ṭhākura) and Mādhava (Bhakti-ratnākara 11.730; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). With Gadādhara Paṇḍita always with the Lord, fanning Him with the cāmara; turned the water of a pond into honey for the Lord and Nityānanda (Madhu-puṣkariṇī); had three Gaura deities made (Śrīkhaṇḍa, Kāṭoyā, Gaṅgānagara). At his disappearance festival Śrīnivāsa was in charge and Vīrabhadra came.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Madhumatī, Rādhā's sakhī who supplies honey.

Disappearance: the record had Agrahāyaṇa śukla ekādaśī; the Bhakti-ratnākara and the Abhidhāna: kṛṣṇa ekādaśī.
Dates/place from B. V. Tīrtha, «Sri Chaitanya: His Associates».

fields.name: Śrī Śivānanda Sena
fields.notes:
A Vaidya of Kumārahaṭṭa who led and paid for the Bengal devotees going to Purī every year (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Madhya 16.19-27). Sons: Caitanya dāsa, Rāmadāsa and Paramānanda (Kavi Karṇapūra); nephew Śrīkānta Sena; family priest Śrīnātha Paṇḍita. Nityānanda kicked him and he rejoiced (Antya 12.18-38); the dog he took care of was liberated (Antya 1).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: the gopīs Vīrā and Dūtī (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 176).

fields.name: Śrī Vāsudeva Ghoṣa
fields.aka: Vāsudeva Ghosh, Vāsu Ghoṣa, Vāsudeva Ghoṣa Ṭhākura
fields.works: Songs on Gaura and Kṛṣṇa (yadi gaura nā hata…); Gaurāṅga-carita and Nimāi-sannyāsa (ascribed, history of Medinipur)
fields.notes:
A north-Rāḍhī Kāyastha, brother of Govinda and Mādhava Ghoṣa: «Govinda, Mādhava, Vāsudeva — three brothers; Caitanya and Nitāi danced in their kīrtana» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.115). Sent with Nityānanda to Bengal (Ādi 10.117-118); came every year to Purī for Ratha-yātrā (Madhya 13). Lived at Tamluk, where there is a deity of the Lord with a unique gesture (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Guṇatuṅgā, who sang Viśākhā's songs (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 188).

fields.name: Śrī Vakreśvara Paṇḍita
fields.disappearance: Āṣāḍha śukla saptamī (Gauḍīya calendar); Dhyānacandra's Paddhati: Āṣāḍha śukla ṣaṣṭhī
fields.place: Born at Guptipāḍā near Triveṇī; Navadvīpa; Purī (the Gambhīrā in Kāśī Miśra's house)
fields.disciples: Śrī Gopāla Guru Gosvāmī; many disciples in Orissa
fields.notes:
Danced seventy-two hours in Śrīvāsa's house (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.17); by his mercy Devānanda Paṇḍita was forgiven (Caitanya-bhāgavata Antya 3); the dancer of the Ratha-yātrā kīrtana parties; after the Lord kept the Gambhīrā, where Gopāla Guru set up Rādhākānta. Śākhā-nirṇayāmṛta 36 counts him in Gadādhara's branch. Older than the Lord (Caitanya-candrodaya 8.33).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Aniruddha; the sakhī Śaśirekhā also entered him (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 71-73); Tuṅgavidyā according to Dhyānacandra.

Disappearance: the record had Āṣāḍha śukla ṣaṣṭhī (Dhyānacandra); the Gauḍīya calendar keeps śukla saptamī.
Dates/place from B. V. Tīrtha, «Sri Chaitanya: His Associates».

fields.name: Śrī Gopāla Guru Gosvāmī
fields.aka: Gopāl Guru Gosvāmī, Gopāla Guru, Makaradhvaja Paṇḍita (former name)
fields.place: Purī: the Gambhīrā (Rādhākānta Maṭha) in Kāśī Miśra's house; Vaṁśīvaṭa in Vṛndāvana (samādhi)
fields.works: Gaura-govindārcana-paddhati (Smaraṇa-paddhati); Vakreśvarāṣṭaka; a commentary on the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra
fields.notes:
An Oriya brāhmaṇa, son of Murāri Paṇḍita, named Makaradhvaja before; the Lord called him Gopāla, and «Guru» for his remark about chanting (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Mahānta of the Rādhākānta Maṭha at the Gambhīrā after Vakreśvara; installed Rādhā and Lalitā beside Rādhākānta and dancing Gaura-Nitāi. Met Narottama (Bhakti-ratnākara 8.382-389). Learnt rasa under Svarūpa Dāmodara and Raghunātha dāsa. His wooden mūrti is in the jagamohana of Rādhākānta.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: according to some, Tuṅgavidyā.

fields.name: Śrī Vaṁśīvadana Ṭhākura
fields.aka: Vamsivadana Ṭhākura, Vansivadananda Ṭhākura, Vaṁśīvadanānanda Ṭhākura, Vaṁśī dāsa
fields.appearance: Caitra pūrṇimā (Madhu-pūrṇimā), 1416 Śaka (1495); some say 1427 or 1428 Śaka (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna; Gauḍīya calendar)
fields.notes:
Son of Chakaḍi Caṭṭopādhyāya, a kulīna brāhmaṇa; Mahāprabhu and Advaita were in the house at his birth. After the Lord's sannyāsa he looked after Śacī and Viṣṇupriyā and, with Viṣṇupriyā's leave, installed her Gaura deity (served by the descendants of Yādava Miśra). Last years at Bilvagrāma; the Bhaṭṭācāryas there are his descendants. His grandson Rāmacandra Gosvāmī; his great-grandson Vallabha dāsa wrote the Vaṁśī-vilāsa (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Kṛṣṇa's flute (vaṁśī) (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 179).
Dates/place from B. V. Tīrtha, «Sri Chaitanya: His Associates».

fields.name: Śrī Kavi Karṇapūra
fields.aka: Kavi Karṇapūra, Paramānanda Sena, Purīdāsa, Paramānanda dāsa, Paramānanda Sen (Kavi Karṇapūra Gosvāmī)
fields.guru: Śrīnātha Paṇḍita (dīkṣā), a disciple of Advaita Ācārya
fields.works: Śrī Caitanya-candrodaya-nāṭaka (1494 Śaka); Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā; Ānanda-vṛndāvana-campū; Caitanya-carita-mahākāvya; Alaṅkāra-kaustubha; Kṛṣṇāhnika-kaumudī; Āryā-śataka; Rādhā-kṛṣṇa-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā; commentary on the tenth canto; Caitanya-sahasra-nāma-stotra
fields.notes:
Youngest son of Śivānanda Sena; the Lord named him Purīdāsa before his birth; at seven he spoke a verse before the Lord and Svarūpa Dāmodara named him Karṇapūra (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Antya 16.65-76). Brothers Caitanya dāsa and Rāmadāsa.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: the sakhī Guṇacūḍā (Vaiṣṇavācāra-darpaṇa).

fields.name: Śrī Rāghava Paṇḍita
fields.notes:
«The Lord's foremost servant in food» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.24); with his sister Damayantī prepared every year the bags of food for the Lord (Rāghavera jhāli, Antya 10). Cooked for Nityānanda, performed His abhiṣeka at Pāṇihāṭi and garlanded Him with kadamba flowers (Caitanya-bhāgavata Antya 5; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Dhaniṣṭhā, who gave Kṛṣṇa abundant foodstuffs (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 166).

fields.name: Śrī Prabodhānanda Sarasvatī
fields.works: Śrī Vṛndāvana-mahimāmṛta; Śrī Rādhā-rasa-sudhānidhi; Śrī Caitanya-candrāmṛta; Saṅgīta-mādhava; Āścarya-rāsa-prabandha; Navadvīpa-śataka; commentaries (Śruti-stuti, Kāma-gāyatrī, Gīta-govinda)
fields.notes:
Brother of Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa of Śrī Raṅgam; uncle and guru of Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī; lived in Vṛndāvana (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Growse ascribed the Rādhā-rasa-sudhānidhi to Hita Harivaṁśa; the Abhidhāna gives it to Prabodhānanda.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Tuṅgavidyā (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 163).

Not Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī of Kāśī, who has his own record (Whisper, 06-11-2026: two persons; the Gauḍīya Maṭha holds they were one).
